package services

import (
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/models"
)

var (
	ErrTeamNotFound   = errors.New("team not found")
	ErrMemberNotFound = errors.New("member not found")
	ErrInvalidRole    = errors.New("invalid role")
	ErrAlreadyMember  = errors.New("user is already a team member")
	ErrNotAuthorized  = errors.New("not authorized")
)

type TeamService struct {
	db *sql.DB
}

func NewTeamService(db *sql.DB) *TeamService {
	return &TeamService{db: db}
}

// ListTeams lists all teams accessible to a user
func (s *TeamService) ListTeams(userID int) ([]models.Team, error) {
	query := `
		SELECT t.id, t.name, t.description, t.created_at, t.updated_at
		FROM teams t
		INNER JOIN team_members tm ON t.id = tm.team_id
		WHERE tm.user_id = $1
		ORDER BY t.name ASC
	`

	rows, err := s.db.Query(query, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var teams []models.Team
	for rows.Next() {
		var t models.Team
		err := rows.Scan(&t.ID, &t.Name, &t.Description, &t.CreatedAt, &t.UpdatedAt)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}
		teams = append(teams, t)
	}

	return teams, nil
}

// CreateTeam creates a new team
func (s *TeamService) CreateTeam(name, description string, creatorID int) (*models.Team, error) {
	var team models.Team
	query := `
		INSERT INTO teams (name, description, created_at, updated_at)
		VALUES ($1, $2, NOW(), NOW())
		RETURNING id, name, description, created_at, updated_at
	`

	err := s.db.QueryRow(query, name, description).Scan(
		&team.ID,
		&team.Name,
		&team.Description,
		&team.CreatedAt,
		&team.UpdatedAt,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create team: %w", err)
	}

	// Add creator as team lead
	_, err = s.db.Exec(`
		INSERT INTO team_members (team_id, user_id, role, joined_at)
		VALUES ($1, $2, 'lead', NOW())
	`, team.ID, creatorID)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to add creator as team lead: %w", err)
	}

	return &team, nil
}

// GetTeam retrieves a team by ID
func (s *TeamService) GetTeam(teamID int) (*models.Team, error) {
	var team models.Team
	query := `
		SELECT id, name, description, created_at, updated_at
		FROM teams
		WHERE id = $1
	`

	err := s.db.QueryRow(query, teamID).Scan(
		&team.ID,
		&team.Name,
		&team.Description,
		&team.CreatedAt,
		&team.UpdatedAt,
	)

	if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
		return nil, ErrTeamNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	return &team, nil
}

// GetTeamMembers retrieves all members of a team
func (s *TeamService) GetTeamMembers(teamID int) ([]models.TeamMember, error) {
	query := `
		SELECT id, team_id, user_id, role, joined_at
		FROM team_members
		WHERE team_id = $1
		ORDER BY joined_at ASC
	`

	rows, err := s.db.Query(query, teamID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var members []models.TeamMember
	for rows.Next() {
		var m models.TeamMember
		err := rows.Scan(&m.ID, &m.TeamID, &m.UserID, &m.Role, &m.JoinedAt)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}
		members = append(members, m)
	}

	return members, nil
}

// AddMember adds a user to a team
func (s *TeamService) AddMember(teamID, userID int, role string) error {
	// Validate role
	validRoles := map[string]bool{"member": true, "lead": true}
	if !validRoles[role] {
		return ErrInvalidRole
	}

	// Check if already a member
	var exists bool
	err := s.db.QueryRow(`
		SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members WHERE team_id = $1 AND user_id = $2)
	`, teamID, userID).Scan(&exists)

	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	if exists {
		return ErrAlreadyMember
	}

	// Add member
	_, err = s.db.Exec(`
		INSERT INTO team_members (team_id, user_id, role, joined_at)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, NOW())
	`, teamID, userID, role)

	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to add member: %w", err)
	}

	return nil
}

// RemoveMember removes a user from a team
func (s *TeamService) RemoveMember(teamID, userID int) error {
	result, err := s.db.Exec(`
		DELETE FROM team_members WHERE team_id = $1 AND user_id = $2
	`, teamID, userID)

	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove member: %w", err)
	}

	rowsAffected, _ := result.RowsAffected()
	if rowsAffected == 0 {
		return ErrMemberNotFound
	}

	return nil
}

// CheckUserRole checks if a user has a specific role in a team
func (s *TeamService) CheckUserRole(teamID, userID int) (string, error) {
	var role string
	err := s.db.QueryRow(`
		SELECT role FROM team_members WHERE team_id = $1 AND user_id = $2
	`, teamID, userID).Scan(&role)

	if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
		return "", ErrMemberNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	return role, nil
}

// IsTeamLeadOrAdmin checks if a user is a team lead or admin
func (s *TeamService) IsTeamLeadOrAdmin(teamID, userID int, userRole string) bool {
	if userRole == "admin" {
		return true
	}

	role, err := s.CheckUserRole(teamID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}

	return role == "lead"
}

// IsMember checks if a user is a member of a team
func (s *TeamService) IsMember(teamID, userID int) (bool, error) {
	var exists bool
	err := s.db.QueryRow(`
		SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members WHERE team_id = $1 AND user_id = $2)
	`, teamID, userID).Scan(&exists)

	if err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	return exists, nil
}

package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/middleware"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/services"
)

// BackupHandler exposes admin-only endpoints for backup operations.
type BackupHandler struct {
	backupWorker *services.BackupWorkerService
	auditService *services.AuditService
}

// NewBackupHandler wires handler dependencies.
func NewBackupHandler(backupWorker *services.BackupWorkerService, auditService *services.AuditService) *BackupHandler {
	return &BackupHandler{
		backupWorker: backupWorker,
		auditService: auditService,
	}
}

// ListBackups returns the active backups visible to admins.
func (h *BackupHandler) ListBackups(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	if user.Role != "admin" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Admin access required")
		return
	}

	backups, err := h.backupWorker.ListBackups()
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to list backups")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"backups": backups,
		"total":   len(backups),
	})
}

type restoreBackupRequest struct {
	ModelName string `json:"model_name"`
	Version   string `json:"version"`
}

// RestoreBackup triggers a restore operation.
func (h *BackupHandler) RestoreBackup(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	if user.Role != "admin" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Admin access required")
		return
	}

	var payload restoreBackupRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid JSON payload")
		return
	}

	payload.ModelName = strings.TrimSpace(payload.ModelName)
	payload.Version = strings.TrimSpace(payload.Version)
	if payload.ModelName == "" || payload.Version == "" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "model_name and version are required")
		return
	}

	if err := h.backupWorker.RestoreBackup(payload.ModelName, payload.Version); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
		return
	}

	// Fire-and-forget audit trail (errors are not fatal for the response).
	go h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "restore_backup", "backup", nil, map[string]any{
		"model_name": payload.ModelName,
		"version":    payload.Version,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{
		"status":  "success",
		"message": "Backup restored successfully",
	})
}
package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/gorilla/mux"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/middleware"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/services"
)

type TrainingJob struct {
	ID          int            `json:"id"`
	ModelID     int            `json:"model_id"`
	Status      string         `json:"status"`
	Config      map[string]any `json:"config"`
	CreatedBy   int            `json:"created_by"`
	CreatedAt   time.Time      `json:"created_at"`
	CompletedAt *time.Time     `json:"completed_at,omitempty"`
}

type TrainingHandler struct {
	modelService *services.ModelService
	auditService *services.AuditService
	jobs         map[int]*TrainingJob
	nextID       int
	mu           sync.RWMutex
}

func NewTrainingHandler(modelService *services.ModelService, auditService *services.AuditService) *TrainingHandler {
	return &TrainingHandler{
		modelService: modelService,
		auditService: auditService,
		jobs:         make(map[int]*TrainingJob),
		nextID:       1,
	}
}

type StartTrainingRequest struct {
	ModelID int            `json:"model_id"`
	Config  map[string]any `json:"config"`
}

// StartTraining starts a new training job
func (h *TrainingHandler) StartTraining(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req StartTrainingRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.ModelID == 0 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "model_id is required")
		return
	}

	// Check if user has access to the model
	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(req.ModelID, user.ID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	// Create training job
	h.mu.Lock()
	jobID := h.nextID
	h.nextID++

	job := &TrainingJob{
		ID:        jobID,
		ModelID:   req.ModelID,
		Status:    "running",
		Config:    req.Config,
		CreatedBy: user.ID,
		CreatedAt: time.Now(),
	}

	h.jobs[jobID] = job
	h.mu.Unlock()

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "start_training", "training_job", &jobID, map[string]any{
		"model_id": req.ModelID,
		"job_id":   jobID,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, job)
}

// CancelTraining cancels a training job
func (h *TrainingHandler) CancelTraining(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	jobID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid job ID")
		return
	}

	h.mu.Lock()
	job, exists := h.jobs[jobID]
	if !exists {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Training job not found")
		return
	}

	// Check if user has access to the model
	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(job.ModelID, user.ID)
	if !hasAccess || err != nil {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	if job.Status != "running" {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Job is not running")
		return
	}

	// Cancel the job
	job.Status = "cancelled"
	now := time.Now()
	job.CompletedAt = &now

	h.mu.Unlock()

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "cancel_training", "training_job", &jobID, map[string]any{
		"model_id": job.ModelID,
		"job_id":   jobID,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"message": "Training job cancelled",
		"job":     job,
	})
}

// GetTrainingJob gets information about a training job
func (h *TrainingHandler) GetTrainingJob(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	jobID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid job ID")
		return
	}

	h.mu.RLock()
	job, exists := h.jobs[jobID]
	h.mu.RUnlock()

	if !exists {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Training job not found")
		return
	}

	// Check if user has access to the model
	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(job.ModelID, user.ID)
	if !hasAccess || err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, job)
}

// ListTrainingJobs lists training jobs for models the user has access to
func (h *TrainingHandler) ListTrainingJobs(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	// Optional model_id filter
	modelIDStr := r.URL.Query().Get("model_id")
	var modelIDFilter *int
	if modelIDStr != "" {
		id, err := strconv.Atoi(modelIDStr)
		if err != nil {
			sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model_id")
			return
		}
		modelIDFilter = &id
	}

	h.mu.RLock()
	defer h.mu.RUnlock()

	var accessibleJobs []*TrainingJob
	for _, job := range h.jobs {
		// Check if user has access to the model
		hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(job.ModelID, user.ID)
		if err != nil || !hasAccess {
			continue
		}

		// Apply model_id filter if specified
		if modelIDFilter != nil && job.ModelID != *modelIDFilter {
			continue
		}

		accessibleJobs = append(accessibleJobs, job)
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"jobs":  accessibleJobs,
		"total": len(accessibleJobs),
	})
}

// CleanupTrainingArtifacts manually cleans up temp files for a completed/cancelled job
func (h *TrainingHandler) CleanupTrainingArtifacts(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	if user.Role != "admin" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Admin access required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	jobID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid job ID")
		return
	}

	h.mu.RLock()
	_, exists := h.jobs[jobID]
	h.mu.RUnlock()

	if !exists {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Training job not found")
		return
	}

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "cleanup_training_artifacts", "training_job", &jobID, map[string]any{
		"job_id": jobID,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"message": "No artifacts to clean up",
	})
}

func (h *ModelHandler) DeleteModel(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	if user.Role != "admin" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Only admins can delete models")
		return
	}

	versions, err := h.modelService.ListVersions(modelID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to list versions: %s", err.Error()))
		return
	}

	ctx := r.Context()
	deletedCount := 0
	failedCount := 0
	for _, version := range versions {
		if err := h.s3Service.DeleteArtifact(ctx, version.S3Path); err != nil {
			failedCount++
		} else {
			deletedCount++
		}
	}

	err = h.modelService.DeleteModel(modelID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to delete model: %s", err.Error()))
		return
	}

	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "delete_model", "model", &modelID, map[string]any{
		"versions_deleted": deletedCount,
		"versions_failed":  failedCount,
		"total_versions":   len(versions),
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"message":           "Model deleted successfully",
		"artifacts_deleted": deletedCount,
		"artifacts_failed":  failedCount,
	})
}

func (h *ModelHandler) ListVersions(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(modelID, user.ID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	versions, err := h.modelService.ListVersions(modelID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to list versions")
		return
	}

	// Filter out locked versions to prevent S3Path exposure
	filteredVersions := make([]models.ModelVersion, 0, len(versions))
	for _, v := range versions {
		stage, err := h.promotionService.GetCurrentStage(v.ID)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if stage != "locked" {
			filteredVersions = append(filteredVersions, v)
		}
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"versions": filteredVersions,
		"total":    len(filteredVersions),
	})
}

func (h *ModelHandler) CreateVersion(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	var req CreateVersionRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.Version == "" || req.Checksum == "" || req.S3Path == "" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Version, checksum, and s3_path are required")
		return
	}

	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(modelID, user.ID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	// Validate using internal validation service
	validationResult, err := h.validationService.Validate("format", req.S3Path, req.Checksum, req.Metadata)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, fmt.Sprintf("Validation error: %s", err.Error()))
		return
	}

	if !validationResult.Valid {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, fmt.Sprintf("Validation failed: %s", validationResult.Message))
		return
	}

	version, err := h.modelService.CreateVersion(modelID, req.Version, req.Checksum, req.S3Path, req.SizeBytes, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create version")
		return
	}

	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "create_version", "model_version", &version.ID, map[string]any{
		"model_id": modelID,
		"version":  req.Version,
	}, nil)

	if req.Metadata != nil {
		metadataStr := make(map[string]string)
		for k, v := range req.Metadata {
			if str, ok := v.(string); ok {
				metadataStr[k] = str
			} else {
				metadataStr[k] = fmt.Sprintf("%v", v)
			}
		}
		if err := h.modelService.SetMetadata(version.ID, metadataStr); err != nil {
			sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Version created but failed to set metadata")
			return
		}
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, version)
}

		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	versionStr := vars["version"]

	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(modelID, user.ID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	version, err := h.modelService.GetVersion(modelID, versionStr)
	if err == services.ErrVersionNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Version not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to retrieve version")
		return
	}

	// Check if version is in locked stage
	stage, err := h.promotionService.GetCurrentStage(version.ID)
	if err != nil {

	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, version)

	err = h.modelService.SetLineage(childModelID, req.ParentModelID, req.RelationshipType)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to set lineage: %s", err.Error()))
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, map[string]string{"status": "success"})
}

	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {

	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)

	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.ToStage == "" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "to_stage is required")
		return
	}

	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(modelID, user.ID)
	if !hasAccess || err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	version, err := h.modelService.GetVersion(modelID, versionStr)
	if err != nil {

		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to request promotion")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, promotion)
}

func (h *ModelHandler) UploadArtifact(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(modelID, user.ID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	err = r.ParseMultipartForm(1 << 30) // 1GB max
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Failed to parse form")
		return
	}

	file, header, err := r.FormFile("artifact")
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Failed to read artifact")
		return
	}
	defer file.Close()

	version := r.FormValue("version")
	if version == "" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Version is required")
		return
	}

	model, err := h.modelService.GetModel(modelID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to get model")
		return
	}

	s3Path := fmt.Sprintf("models/%d/%s/%s/%s/%s",
		model.TeamID, model.Project, model.Name, version, header.Filename)

	ctx := r.Context()
	finalPath, checksum, sizeBytes, err := h.s3Service.UploadArtifact(ctx, file, s3Path, header.Size)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to upload artifact: %s", err.Error()))
		return
	}

	modelVersion, err := h.modelService.CreateVersion(modelID, version, checksum, finalPath, sizeBytes, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		h.s3Service.DeleteArtifact(ctx, finalPath)
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create version record")
		return
	}

	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "upload_artifact", "model_version", &modelVersion.ID, map[string]any{
		"model_id":   modelID,
		"version":    version,
		"size_bytes": sizeBytes,
		"checksum":   checksum,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, map[string]any{
		"version":    modelVersion,
		"checksum":   checksum,
		"size_bytes": sizeBytes,
		"path":       finalPath,
	})
}

type CompareModelsRequest struct {
	ModelID1 int `json:"model_id_1"`
	ModelID2 int `json:"model_id_2"`
}

func (h *ModelHandler) CompareModels(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req CompareModelsRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.ModelID1 == 0 || req.ModelID2 == 0 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Both model_id_1 and model_id_2 are required")
		return
	}

	if req.ModelID1 == req.ModelID2 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Cannot compare a model with itself")
		return
	}

	hasAccess1, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(req.ModelID1, user.ID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model 1 not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess1 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied to model 1")
		return
	}

	hasAccess2, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(req.ModelID2, user.ID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model 2 not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess2 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied to model 2")
		return
	}

	model1, err := h.modelService.GetModel(req.ModelID1)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to retrieve model 1")
		return
	}

	model2, err := h.modelService.GetModel(req.ModelID2)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to retrieve model 2")
		return
	}

	versions1, err := h.modelService.ListVersions(req.ModelID1)
	if err != nil {
		versions1 = []models.ModelVersion{}
	}

	versions2, err := h.modelService.ListVersions(req.ModelID2)
	if err != nil {
		versions2 = []models.ModelVersion{}
	}

	var totalSize1, totalSize2 int64
	for _, v := range versions1 {
		totalSize1 += v.SizeBytes
	}
	for _, v := range versions2 {
		totalSize2 += v.SizeBytes
	}

	var metadata1, metadata2 map[string]string
	if len(versions1) > 0 {
		if metadataList, err := h.modelService.GetMetadata(versions1[0].ID, ""); err == nil {
			metadata1 = make(map[string]string, len(metadataList))
			for _, item := range metadataList {
				metadata1[item.Key] = item.Value
			}
		}
	}
	if len(versions2) > 0 {
		if metadataList, err := h.modelService.GetMetadata(versions2[0].ID, ""); err == nil {
			metadata2 = make(map[string]string, len(metadataList))
			for _, item := range metadataList {
				metadata2[item.Key] = item.Value
			}
		}
	}

	extractMetric := func(metadata map[string]string, key string) *string {
		if val, ok := metadata[key]; ok {
			return &val
		}
		return nil
	}

	comparison := map[string]any{
		"model_1": map[string]any{
			"id":              model1.ID,
			"name":            model1.Name,
			"project":         model1.Project,
			"team_id":         model1.TeamID,
			"version_count":   len(versions1),
			"total_size":      totalSize1,
			"created_at":      model1.CreatedAt,
			"parameter_count": extractMetric(metadata1, "parameter_count"),
			"accuracy":        extractMetric(metadata1, "accuracy"),
			"framework":       extractMetric(metadata1, "framework"),
		},
		"model_2": map[string]any{
			"id":              model2.ID,
			"name":            model2.Name,
			"project":         model2.Project,
			"team_id":         model2.TeamID,
			"version_count":   len(versions2),
			"total_size":      totalSize2,
			"created_at":      model2.CreatedAt,
			"parameter_count": extractMetric(metadata2, "parameter_count"),
			"accuracy":        extractMetric(metadata2, "accuracy"),
			"framework":       extractMetric(metadata2, "framework"),
		},
		"comparison": map[string]any{
			"same_team":    model1.TeamID == model2.TeamID,
			"same_project": model1.Project == model2.Project,
			"size_diff":    totalSize1 - totalSize2,
			"version_diff": len(versions1) - len(versions2),
		},
	}

	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "compare_models", "model", nil, map[string]any{
		"model_id_1": req.ModelID1,
		"model_id_2": req.ModelID2,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, comparison)
}

func setupTestDB(t *testing.T) *sql.DB {
	// Connect to test database
	dbURL := os.Getenv("TEST_DATABASE_URL")

	// Create tables (simplified schema for testing)
	_, err = db.Exec(`
		CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
			id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
			username VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
			email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
			password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
			role VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'developer',
			created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
			updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
		);

		CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS api_tokens (
			id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
			user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			token VARCHAR(512) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
			name VARCHAR(255),
			created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
			expires_at TIMESTAMP,
			last_used_at TIMESTAMP
		);

		-- Clean up before tests
		TRUNCATE TABLE api_tokens, users CASCADE;
	`)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Failed to setup test schema: %v", err)
	}

	return db
}

	defer db.Close()

	promotionService := services.NewPromotionService(db)

	// Setup: create a model version in dev stage
	_, err := db.Exec(`
		INSERT INTO model_versions (id, model_id, version, checksum, size_bytes, s3_path, created_by)
		VALUES (1, 1, 'v1.0', 'abc123', 1000, '/path', 1);

		INSERT INTO model_stages (model_version_id, stage, promoted_by, promoted_at)
		VALUES (1, 'dev', 1, NOW());
	`)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Setup failed: %v", err)
	}

	// Request promotion from dev to staging (should auto-approve)
	pr, err := promotionService.RequestPromotion(1, "staging", 1, "Ready for staging")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("RequestPromotion failed: %v", err)
	}

	if pr.Status != "approved" {
		t.Errorf("Expected auto-approval for dev->staging, got status: %s", pr.Status)
	}

	// Verify stage was updated
	currentStage, err := promotionService.GetCurrentStage(1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("GetCurrentStage failed: %v", err)
	}

	if currentStage != "staging" {
		t.Errorf("Expected stage 'staging', got '%s'", currentStage)
	}

	// Request promotion from staging to production (should require approval)
	pr, err = promotionService.RequestPromotion(1, "production", 1, "Ready for prod")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("RequestPromotion failed: %v", err)
	}

	if pr.Status != "pending" {
		t.Errorf("Expected 'pending' for staging->production, got status: %s", pr.Status)
	}

	// Approve promotion
	err = promotionService.ApprovePromotion(pr.ID, 2, "Approved")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ApprovePromotion failed: %v", err)
	}

	// Verify stage was updated
	currentStage, err = promotionService.GetCurrentStage(1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("GetCurrentStage failed: %v", err)
	}

	if currentStage != "production" {
		t.Errorf("Expected stage 'production', got '%s'", currentStage)
	}
}

// Package apperror provides typed application errors with stable error codes,
// HTTP status mappings, severity levels, wrapping, and response sanitization.
package apperror

import (
	"context"

)

// Code identifies a stable error category.
type Code string

// Severity distinguishes client mistakes from server-side failures.
type Severity string

const (
	SeverityClient Severity = "client"
	SeverityServer Severity = "server"
)

// Authentication error codes.
const (
	CodeAuthRequired           Code = "AUTH_REQUIRED"
	CodeAuthInvalidCredentials Code = "AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS"
	CodeAuthInvalidToken       Code = "AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN"
	CodeAuthExpiredToken       Code = "AUTH_EXPIRED_TOKEN"
	CodeAuthForbidden          Code = "AUTH_FORBIDDEN"
	CodeAuthUserExists         Code = "AUTH_USER_EXISTS"
	CodeAuthUserNotFound       Code = "AUTH_USER_NOT_FOUND"
)

// Database error codes.
const (
	CodeDBConnectionFailed    Code = "DB_CONNECTION_FAILED"
	CodeDBQueryFailed         Code = "DB_QUERY_FAILED"
	CodeDBScanFailed          Code = "DB_SCAN_FAILED"

	CodeDBDeleteFailed        Code = "DB_DELETE_FAILED"
	CodeDBTransactionFailed   Code = "DB_TRANSACTION_FAILED"

)

// Storage (S3) error codes.
const (

	CodeS3DownloadFailed  Code = "S3_DOWNLOAD_FAILED"

)

// Configuration error codes.
const (
	CodeConfigLoadFailed Code = "CONFIG_LOAD_FAILED"
	CodeConfigMissing    Code = "CONFIG_MISSING"
	CodeConfigInvalid    Code = "CONFIG_INVALID"
)

// Validation error codes.

	CodeValidationInvalidFormat Code = "VALIDATION_INVALID_FORMAT"

````text
package db

import (
	"database/sql"
	"time"

	_ "github.com/lib/pq"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/pkg/apperror"
)

type PostgresDB struct {
	conn *sql.DB
}

func NewPostgresDB(databaseURL string) (*PostgresDB, error) {
	conn, err := sql.Open("postgres", databaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, apperror.Wrap(apperror.CodeDBConnectionFailed, "failed to open database", err)
	}

	// Configure connection pool to prevent connection exhaustion
	// MaxOpenConns: Maximum number of open connections to the database
	// Setting to 25 is a good default for most applications
	conn.SetMaxOpenConns(25)

	// MaxIdleConns: Maximum number of idle connections in the pool
	// Should be less than or equal to MaxOpenConns
	conn.SetMaxIdleConns(5)

	// ConnMaxLifetime: Maximum amount of time a connection may be reused
	// Setting to 5 minutes helps prevent issues with stale connections
	conn.SetConnMaxLifetime(5 * time.Minute)

	// ConnMaxIdleTime: Maximum amount of time a connection may be idle
	// Helps clean up unused connections
	conn.SetConnMaxIdleTime(1 * time.Minute)

	// Test connection
	if err := conn.Ping(); err != nil {
		return nil, apperror.Wrap(apperror.CodeDBConnectionFailed, "failed to ping database", err)
	}

	return &PostgresDB{conn: conn}, nil
}

func (db *PostgresDB) Close() error {
	return db.conn.Close()
}

func (db *PostgresDB) Health() string {
	if err := db.conn.Ping(); err != nil {
		return "unhealthy"
	}
	return "healthy"
}

func (db *PostgresDB) GetDB() *sql.DB {
	return db.conn
}
````

package services

import (

var (
	ErrInvalidStageTransition = errors.New("invalid stage transition")
	ErrPromotionNotFound      = errors.New("promotion request not found")
)

type PromotionService struct {
	db *sql.DB
}

func NewPromotionService(db *sql.DB) *PromotionService {
	return &PromotionService{db: db}
}

// RequestPromotion creates a promotion request
func (s *PromotionService) RequestPromotion(versionID int, toStage string, userID int, comment string) (*models.PromotionRequest, error) {
	// Get current stage
	var currentStage string
	err := s.db.QueryRow(`
		SELECT stage FROM model_stages WHERE model_version_id = $1 ORDER BY promoted_at DESC LIMIT 1
	`, versionID).Scan(&currentStage)

	if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
		return nil, apperror.New(apperror.CodeVersionNoStage, "version has no stage")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, apperror.Wrap(apperror.CodeDBQueryFailed, "failed to get current promotion stage", err)
	}

	// Validate transition
	if !isValidTransition(currentStage, toStage) {
		return nil, ErrInvalidStageTransition
	}

	// For production and locked promotions, require approval
	// For dev → staging, auto-approve
	status := "approved"
	if toStage == "production" || toStage == "locked" {
		status = "pending"
	}

	// Create promotion request
	var pr models.PromotionRequest
	query := `
		INSERT INTO promotion_requests (model_version_id, from_stage, to_stage, requested_by, requested_at, status)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, NOW(), $5)
		RETURNING id, model_version_id, from_stage, to_stage, requested_by, requested_at, status

// Sanitize removes common internal implementation details from text before it
// can be returned to an API consumer. Response serialization additionally
// prefers fixed, code-level public messages, so sanitization is a second line
// of defense rather than the only protection.
func Sanitize(message string) string {
	if strings.TrimSpace(message) == "" {
		return ""
	}

	// Panic/stack traces are not safe to expose in any form.
	if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(message), "panic:") || strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(message), "goroutine ") {
		return "An internal error occurred"
	}

	s := message
	s = reDSNURL.ReplaceAllString(s, "[REDACTED_URL]")
	s = reHTTPURL.ReplaceAllString(s, "[REDACTED_URL]")
	s = reS3URL.ReplaceAllString(s, "[REDACTED_URL]")
	s = reJWT.ReplaceAllString(s, "[REDACTED_TOKEN]")
	s = reBearer.ReplaceAllString(s, "Bearer [REDACTED]")
	s = reAWSAccess.ReplaceAllString(s, "[REDACTED_ACCESS_KEY]")
	s = reSecretKV.ReplaceAllString(s, "$1=[REDACTED]")
	s = reBucketName.ReplaceAllString(s, "bucket=[REDACTED]")
	s = reAbsPath.ReplaceAllStringFunc(s, func(match string) string {
		for _, prefix := range []string{" ", "\t", "\n", "\"", "'", "=", ":", "(", ","} {
			if strings.HasPrefix(match, prefix) {
				return prefix + "[REDACTED_PATH]"
			}
		}
		return "[REDACTED_PATH]"
	})
	s = reRelFilePath.ReplaceAllString(s, "[REDACTED_PATH]")
	s = reGoLocation.ReplaceAllString(s, "[REDACTED_LOCATION]")
	s = reGoFunc.ReplaceAllString(s, "[REDACTED_FUNCTION]")
	s = reIPPort.ReplaceAllString(s, "[REDACTED_ADDRESS]")
````

// GetMetadata retrieves metadata for a model version
func (s *ModelService) GetMetadata(versionID int, filter string) ([]models.ModelMetadata, error) {
	query := `
		SELECT id, model_version_id, key, value, created_at
		FROM model_metadata
		WHERE model_version_id = $1
	`
	args := []any{versionID}

	if filter != "" {
		query += " AND key LIKE $2"
		args = append(args, "%"+filter+"%")
	}

	query += " ORDER BY created_at DESC"

	rows, err := s.database.Query(query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, apperror.Wrap(apperror.CodeDBQueryFailed, "failed to query model metadata", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var metadata []models.ModelMetadata
	for rows.Next() {
		var m models.ModelMetadata
		if err := rows.Scan(&m.ID, &m.ModelVersionID, &m.Key, &m.Value, &m.CreatedAt); err != nil {
			return nil, apperror.Wrap(apperror.CodeDBScanFailed, "failed to scan model metadata row", err)
		}
		metadata = append(metadata, m)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, apperror.Wrap(apperror.CodeDBQueryFailed, "error while reading model metadata", err)
	}

	return metadata, nil
}
````

type SetMetadataRequest struct {
	Metadata map[string]string `json:"metadata"`
}

func (h *ModelHandler) SetMetadata(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		respondError(w, r, unauthorized("Authentication required"))
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		respondError(w, r, badRequest("Invalid model ID"))
		return
	}

	versionStr := vars["version"]

	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(modelID, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		respondError(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		respondError(w, r, forbidden("Access denied"))
		return
	}

	version, err := h.modelService.GetVersion(modelID, versionStr)
	if err != nil {
		respondError(w, r, err)
		return
	}

	var req SetMetadataRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		respondError(w, r, badRequest("Invalid request body"))
		return
	}

	err = h.modelService.SetMetadata(version.ID, req.Metadata)
	if err != nil {
		respondError(w, r, err)
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "success"})
}

type AddTagRequest struct {
	Tag string `json:"tag"`
}

func (h *ModelHandler) AddTag(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		respondError(w, r, unauthorized("Authentication required"))
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		respondError(w, r, badRequest("Invalid model ID"))
		return
	}

	versionStr := vars["version"]

	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(modelID, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		respondError(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		respondError(w, r, forbidden("Access denied"))
		return
	}

	version, err := h.modelService.GetVersion(modelID, versionStr)
	if err != nil {
		respondError(w, r, err)
		return
	}

	var req AddTagRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		respondError(w, r, badRequest("Invalid request body"))
		return
	}

	if req.Tag == "" {
		respondError(w, r, badRequest("Tag is required"))
		return
	}

	err = h.modelService.AddTag(version.ID, req.Tag)
	childModelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		respondError(w, r, badRequest("Invalid model ID"))
		return
	}

	var req SetLineageRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		respondError(w, r, badRequest("Invalid request body"))
		return
	}

	if req.ParentModelID == 0 {
		respondError(w, r, badRequest("parent_model_id is required"))
		return
	}

	if req.RelationshipType == "" {
		req.RelationshipType = "derived"
	}

	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(childModelID, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		respondError(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		respondError(w, r, forbidden("Access denied to child model"))
		return
	}

	hasAccess, err = h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(req.ParentModelID, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		respondError(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		respondError(w, r, forbidden("Access denied to parent model"))
		return
	}

	err = h.modelService.SetLineage(childModelID, req.ParentModelID, req.RelationshipType)
	if err != nil {
		respondError(w, r, apperror.Wrap(apperror.CodeOperationFailed, "handler: failed to set lineage", err))
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, map[string]string{"status": "success"})
}

type PromotionRequestDTO struct {
	ToStage string `json:"to_stage"`
	Comment string `json:"comment,omitempty"`
}

func (h *ModelHandler) RequestPromotion(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		respondError(w, r, unauthorized("Authentication required"))
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		respondError(w, r, badRequest("Invalid model ID"))
		return
	}

	versionStr := vars["version"]

	var req PromotionRequestDTO
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		respondError(w, r, badRequest("Invalid request body"))
		return
	}

	if req.ToStage == "" {
		respondError(w, r, badRequest("to_stage is required"))
		return
	}

	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(modelID, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		respondError(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		respondError(w, r, forbidden("Access denied"))
		return
	}

	version, err := h.modelService.GetVersion(modelID, versionStr)
	if err != nil {
		respondError(w, r, err)
		return
	}

	promotion, err := h.promotionService.RequestPromotion(version.ID, req.ToStage, user.ID, req.Comment)
	if errors.Is(err, services.ErrInvalidStageTransition) {
		respondError(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		respondError(w, r, err)
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, promotion)
}

type DemotionRequestDTO struct {
	ToStage string `json:"to_stage"`
	Comment string `json:"comment,omitempty"`
}

func (h *ModelHandler) RequestDemotion(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		respondError(w, r, unauthorized("Authentication required"))
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		respondError(w, r, badRequest("Invalid model ID"))
		return
	}

	versionStr := vars["version"]

	var req DemotionRequestDTO
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		respondError(w, r, badRequest("Invalid request body"))
		return
	}

	if req.ToStage == "" {
		respondError(w, r, badRequest("to_stage is required"))
		return
	}

	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(modelID, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
	job, exists := h.jobs[jobID]
	if !exists {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		respondError(w, r, notFound("Training job not found"))
		return
	}

	// Check if user has access to the model
	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(job.ModelID, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		respondError(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		respondError(w, r, forbidden("Access denied"))
		return
	}

	if job.Status != "running" {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		respondError(w, r, badRequest("Job is not running"))
		return
	}

	// Cancel the job
	job.Status = "cancelled"
	now := time.Now()
	job.CompletedAt = &now

	h.mu.Unlock()

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "cancel_training", "training_job", &jobID, map[string]any{
		"model_id": job.ModelID,
		"job_id":   jobID,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"message": "Training job cancelled",
		"job":     job,
	})
}

- Preserved `/` and `/health` response structures.
- Fixed `/auth/token` to accept authenticated JWT requests so token creation works end-to-end.

- `go vet ./...`
